1.why: All screens use a clean sans-serif typeface with large headings and roomy line height, e.g. the well-spaced paragraphs in the login page info box.

2.why: Instruction text is sentence-case with no italics; the only all-caps strings are the 'NORTHSTAR BANK'/'SECURITY CENTRE' brand labels, and instruction blocks are at most a few lines long.

3.why: The flow renders as a single narrow column with full-width buttons and no horizontal overflow, so it stays readable at the mobile width shown, though the two-column code grid could get tight on smaller phones.

4.why: Most prompts are short and plain ('Enter the six-digit code generated during setup'), but the first screen's demo identity-check box uses jargon such as 'short-lived challenge', 'controlled test mode' and 'mock code'.

5.why: Only the mobile number ('+15551234567') and recovery code ('ABCD-EFGH-JKLM') fields show example placeholders, while the email, identity verification code and authenticator code fields show no example of the expected input.

6.why: Required reading at each step is limited to short headings and notices; the only dense block (the Logs panel) is still just a few lines long at the points where the user must fetch a code from it.

7.why: No copy button or download option is provided for the 32-character setup secret or the recovery codes, and the user is shown hand-typing codes such as 246810, 135790 and 83BY-546P-CKTX.

8.why: The setup screen explicitly says 'Enter it manually in your authenticator app' and no QR code or equivalent alternative appears on any of the 14 screens.

9.why: Code fields are plain text inputs with no visible autofill or password-manager affordance, and one-time codes are transcribed by hand from the Logs panel.

10.why: Each screen has a bold heading naming the current step and a single full-width solid-blue primary button that clearly dominates the secondary links, though no progress indicator is shown.

11.why: Enrolment screens ask for one primary action at a time, but the MFA settings screen presents several main actions at once (Generate replacement codes, Verify recovery code, Log out).

12.why: Status banners plainly state outcomes and next steps ('Setup secret generated. Enter it manually in your authenticator app'; 'Enrolment confirmed.'), though requesting a challenge only posts a technical log line.

13.why: Back links ('Back to setup', 'Back to MFA settings') and re-request buttons ('Get a simulation challenge', 'Generate replacement codes') are available with no lockout or penalty shown, though there is no reveal/hide toggle.

14.why: No error state appears anywhere in the 14 screenshots, so there is no observable error message that states the problem and how to fix it.

15.why: No countdown, expiry warning or session timeout is visible on any screen, and codes remain on screen while the user proceeds at their own pace.
